full_text: Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE OPINION NO. 66 S. 24 May 2010 MR. SERAFIN SANTOS 3305 San Jose Street Sampaloc, Manila Dear Mr. Santos: 2010 This has reference to your earlier letter asking this Department's legal opinion on the following issues, which we summarized as follows: Is the rule under Section 90, which is the prohibition of 1. mayors from practicing their profession, absolute? Is there any exception thereto? 2. Does a b usinessman, elec ted as m unicipal mayor, ha ve to divest himself of his position and stakeholdings held privately in order to comply with such prohibition? In reply thereto, please be informed that this Department had already answered. a similar query in DILG opinion No. 101, series of 2007. In the said legal opiriion, we opined that the prohibition on the local chief executives from practicing their profession or engage in any other occupation under Section 90 of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160) is absolute. Hereto attached is a photocopy of the aforesaid DILG Opinion for your ready perusal. Thank you and warm regards. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: . JES D Ls/17 B. DO ctor III 1 EIV
